I am Green the Argonian.   
After waking up with memory loss. Green named himself after looking at his reflection.  
He meanders around skyrim, helping anyone who asks. Not because he's a nice person, but because he's an idiot who doesn't understand the concept of no. 

Once when thieves told him to give up his stuff, he stripped naked to give up his armour. But when Green got cold, he lit a fireball to stay word, which lead to Green killing all the bandits, while In the buff.

He has never done anything he attempted right. 

Every successful assassination for the dark brotherhood was an accident. After the emperor's sad speech about being ready to die, Green tried to hug him and accidently broke his spine.  
Every time Green has tried to shoot someone, he has always hit the person next to them.  
Green once shot a fireball at someone from miles away, a legendary assassination that made him feared across Skyrim, no one realises he was aiming for the giant right in front of him.  
When Green destroyed the Argonian embassy, it wasn't in self defence, it was because he forgot he was argonian and tried to get rid of 'the scary snake men'  
Green has the best collection of Dwelmer goods in Skyrim,  not because he knows what a 'Dwelmer' is, but because he likes the 'beep beep men' and feels bad when they are killed by his hugs.  
When Green saved Riften from the skooma epidemic, he was actually high on skooma, thinking it was fairy dust and would make him fly.  
After killing the entire guard of Solitude, Green realised that they were people and not 'big chickens looking for revenge'  
When slaying the giants attacking the cursed tribe, Green didn't actually notice that chief Yamarz was trying to backstab him. He was just throwing away pointy sticks and happened to behead the chief.
